pob.text: Then Yahweh spoke to Aaron: “And I[a], behold, I have given you the charge of my contributions, all the holy gifts of the sons of Israel. I have given them to you as your anointing portion[c][b], and to your sons as a permanent statute.”

pob.text: You shall eat it in a most holy place; every male may eat it. It shall be holy to you.

pob.text: And this is yours: the contribution of their gifts[a], with all the wave offerings of the sons of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and your daughters with you, as a permanent statute[b]. Everyone in your house who is clean may eat it.

pob.text: All the best of the oil[a], and all the best of the new wine and grain—their firstfruits, which they give to Yahweh—I have given to you.

spob.text: I have given you all the best of the oil, new wine, and grain—the first part of their produce, which they give to Yahweh.

public_domain_references.asv: Thus ye also shall offer a heave-offering unto Jehovah of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and thereof ye shall give Jehovah’s heave-offering to Aaron the priest.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD’s heave offering to Aaron the priest.
public_domain_references.brenton: So shall ye also separate them from all the offerings of the Lord out of all your tithes, whatsoever ye shall receive from the children of Israel; and ye shall give of them an offering to the Lord to Aaron the priest.

pob.text: From all your gifts you shall lift up every offering of Yahweh[a]; from all its best part[b], the holy portion from it.

spob.text: From all the gifts given to you, lift up every offering for Yahweh. Set apart the holy portion from the best part of those gifts.

public_domain_references.bsb: You must present the offering due the LORD from all the best of every gift, the holiest part of it.’
public_domain_references.web: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to Yahweh, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’
public_domain_references.asv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave-offering of Jehovah, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
public_domain_references.kjv: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, [even] the hallowed part thereof out of it.
public_domain_references.brenton: Of all your gifts ye shall offer an offering to the Lord, and of every first-fruit the consecrated part from it.

pob.text: And you shall say to them[a], ‘When you lift up its best part from it, it shall be counted to the Levites as the produce of the threshing floor and as the produce of the winepress.’

spob.text: Say to the Levites, “When you present the best part[a] of the tithe as a contribution, the tithe will be credited to you as your own produce, like grain from a threshing floor or wine from a winepress.”

public_domain_references.bsb: Therefore say to the Levites, ‘When you have presented the best part, it will be reckoned to you as the produce of the threshing floor or winepress.
public_domain_references.web: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.
public_domain_references.asv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye heave the best thereof from it, then it shall be reckoned unto the Levites as the increase of the threshing-floor, and as the increase of the winepress.
public_domain_references.kjv: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt say to them, When ye shall offer the first-fruits from it, then shall it be reckoned to the Levites as produce from the threshing-floor, and as produce from the wine-press.

pob.text: You and your household may eat it in any place[c][b][a], because it is your wages in return for your service in the tent of meeting.

spob.text: You and everyone in your household may eat it anywhere. It is your pay for serving in the tent of meeting.

public_domain_references.bsb: And you and your households may eat the rest of it anywhere; it is the compensation for your work at the Tent of Meeting.
public_domain_references.web: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
public_domain_references.asv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward in return for your service in the tent of meeting.
public_domain_references.kjv: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it [is] your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye shall eat it in any place, ye and your families; for this is your reward for your services in the tabernacle of witness.

pob.text: And you will bear no sin because of it when you lift up its best part from it[a]. You shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel[b], and you shall not die.

spob.text: You will not become guilty in handling the tithe when you lift up its best part as an offering.[a] Do not treat the holy offerings of the sons of Israel as ordinary,[b] and you will not die.

public_domain_references.bsb: Once you have presented the best part of it, you will not incur guilt because of it. But you must not defile the sacred offerings of the Israelites, or else you will die.’”
public_domain_references.web: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”
public_domain_references.asv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best thereof: and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.
public_domain_references.kjv: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
public_domain_references.brenton: And ye shall not bear sin by reason of it, for ye shall have offered an offering of first-fruits from it, and ye shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that ye die not.

pob.text: And Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

spob.text: Yahweh spoke to Moses and Aaron:

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
public_domain_references.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
public_domain_references.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
public_domain_references.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
public_domain_references.brenton: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,

pob.text: This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded, saying: Speak to the sons of Israel, that they bring to you a red heifer, whole, in which there is no defect, and on which no yoke has come.

spob.text: This is a requirement of the law that the LORD commanded: “Tell the Israelites to bring you a red heifer that is whole and has no defect, and that has never worn a yoke.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded: Instruct the Israelites to bring you an unblemished red heifer that has no defect and has never been placed under a yoke.
public_domain_references.web: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.
public_domain_references.asv: This is the statute of the law which Jehovah hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, [and] upon which never came yoke.
public_domain_references.kjv: This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein [is] no blemish, [and] upon which never came yoke:
public_domain_references.brenton: This is the constitution of the law, as the Lord has commanded, saying, Speak to the sons of Israel, and let them take for thee a red heifer without spot, which has no spot on her, and on which no yoke has been put.

pob.text: You shall give it to Eleazar the priest[a], and he shall bring it outside the camp[b], and it shall be slaughtered before him.

spob.text: You must give the heifer to Eleazar the priest. He must take it outside the camp. There it must be slaughtered in his presence.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Give it to Eleazar the priest, and he will have it brought outside the camp and slaughtered in his presence.
public_domain_references.web: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.
public_domain_references.asv: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
public_domain_references.kjv: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and [one] shall slay her before his face:
public_domain_references.brenton: And thou shalt give her to Eleazar the priest; and they shall bring her out of the camp into a clean place, and shall kill her before his face.

pob.text: Then Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and sprinkle some of its blood seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting[a].

spob.text: Then Eleazar the priest must use his finger to take some of the heifer’s blood. He must sprinkle some of the blood seven times toward the front of the tent of meeting.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Eleazar the priest is to take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle it seven times toward the front of the Tent of Meeting.
public_domain_references.web: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.
public_domain_references.asv: and Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the tent of meeting seven times.
public_domain_references.kjv: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
public_domain_references.brenton: And Eleazar shall take of her blood, and sprinkle of her blood seven times in front of the tabernacle of witness.

pob.text: And he shall burn the cow before his eyes; its hide[a], its flesh, its blood, along with its dung, he shall burn.

spob.text: The cow must be burned in his sight. He must burn the whole animal—its hide, flesh, and blood, together with its dung.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the heifer must be burned in his sight. Its hide, its flesh, and its blood are to be burned, along with its dung.
public_domain_references.web: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.
public_domain_references.asv: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
public_domain_references.kjv: And [one] shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall burn her to ashes before him; and her skin and her flesh and her blood, with her dung, shall be consumed.

pob.text: Then the priest shall take cedar wood[a], hyssop, and scarlet yarn, and throw them into the midst of the burning of the cow.

spob.text: Then the priest must take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet yarn and throw them into the middle of the fire as the cow burns.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The priest is to take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet wool and throw them onto the burning heifer.
public_domain_references.web: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.
public_domain_references.asv: and the priest shall take cedar-wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast [it] into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet wool, and they shall cast them into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

pob.text: Then the priest shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water[a], and afterward he may come into the camp[b]; but the priest shall be unclean until evening.

spob.text: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. After that, he may enter the camp, but he will remain ritually unclean until evening.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the priest must wash his clothes and bathe his body in water; after that he may enter the camp, but he will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
public_domain_references.web: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.
public_domain_references.asv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
public_domain_references.brenton: And the priest shall wash his garments, and bathe his body in water, and afterwards he shall go into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean till evening.

pob.text: The one who burns it shall wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water[b][a], and he shall be unclean until the evening.

spob.text: The person who burns the heifer must wash his clothes in water and bathe his body in water. He will remain ritually unclean until evening.

public_domain_references.bsb: The one who burned the heifer must also wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he too will be ceremonially unclean until evening.
public_domain_references.web: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.
public_domain_references.asv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he that burns her shall wash his garments, and bathe his body, and shall be unclean till evening.

pob.text: Then a clean man shall gather the ashes of the heifer and place them outside the camp in a clean place[a], and they shall be kept for the congregation of the sons of Israel for water for impurity[b]; it is a sin offering.

spob.text: Then a ceremonially clean man must gather the heifer’s ashes and put them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. The ashes must be kept for the community of Israel to make water for removing ritual impurity. It is a sin offering.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to gather up the ashes of the heifer and store them in a ceremonially clean place outside the camp. They must be kept by the congregation of Israel for preparing the water of purification; this is for purification from sin.
public_domain_references.web: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.
public_domain_references.asv: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water for impurity: it is a sin-offering.
public_domain_references.kjv: And a man [that is] clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay [them] up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it [is] a purification for sin.
public_domain_references.brenton: And a clean man shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up in a clean place outside the camp; and they shall be for the congregation of the children of Israel to keep: it is the water of sprinkling, a purification.

pob.text: And the one who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes[a], and he shall be unclean until the evening[b]. And this shall be for the sons of Israel and for the sojourner who sojourns among them as a permanent statute.

spob.text: The person who collects the heifer’s ashes must wash his clothes. He will remain ritually unclean until evening. This is a permanent law for the sons of Israel[a] and for every foreign resident among them.

public_domain_references.bsb: The man who has gathered up the ashes of the heifer must also wash his clothes, and he will be ceremonially unclean until evening. This is a permanent statute for the Israelites and for the foreigner residing among them.
public_domain_references.web: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.
public_domain_references.asv: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
public_domain_references.brenton: And he that gathers up the ashes of the heifer shall wash his garments, and shall be unclean until evening; and it shall be a perpetual statute for the children of Israel and for the strangers joined to them.

pob.text: Whoever touches a dead body of any person shall be unclean seven days[a][b].

spob.text: If anyone touches a human dead body, that person will be ritually unclean for seven days.

public_domain_references.bsb: Whoever touches any dead body will be unclean for seven days.
public_domain_references.web: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.asv: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days:
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.brenton: He that touches the dead body of any man, shall be unclean seven days.

pob.text: He shall purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day[a], and he will be clean; but if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day[b], he will not be clean.

spob.text: He must purify himself with the purification water on both the third and seventh days. Then he will be ritually clean. But if he does not purify himself on both days, he will not be clean.

public_domain_references.bsb: He must purify himself with the water on the third day and on the seventh day; then he will be clean. But if he does not purify himself on the third and seventh days, he will not be clean.
public_domain_references.web: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
public_domain_references.asv: the same shall purify himself therewith on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
public_domain_references.brenton: He shall be purified on the third day and the seventh day, and shall be clean; but if he be not purged on the third day and the seventh day, he shall not be clean.

pob.text: Everyone who touches a dead person[a], the body of a man who has died, and does not purify himself, has defiled the tabernacle of Yahweh, and that person shall be cut off from Israel. Because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is still on him.

spob.text: Anyone who touches the dead body of a person but does not ritually purify himself defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle. That person shall be cut off from Israel.[a] Because the water for purification[b] was not sprinkled on him, he remains unclean; his uncleanness is still on him.

public_domain_references.bsb: Anyone who touches a human corpse and fails to purify himself defiles the tabernacle of the LORD. That person must be cut off from Israel. He remains unclean, because the water of purification has not been sprinkled on him, and his uncleanness is still on him.
public_domain_references.web: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles Yahweh’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.
public_domain_references.asv: Whosoever toucheth a dead person, the body of a man that hath died, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of Jehovah; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water for impurity was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
public_domain_references.kjv: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness [is] yet upon him.
public_domain_references.brenton: Every one that touches the carcase of the person of a man, if he should have died, and [the other] not have been purified, has defiled the tabernacle of the Lord: that soul shall be cut off from Israel, because the water of sprinkling has not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.

pob.text: This is the law: when a man dies in a tent[a], everyone who enters the tent and everyone who is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.

spob.text: This is the law: When a man dies in a tent, anyone who enters that tent and everyone inside it[a] will be ritually unclean for seven days.

public_domain_references.bsb: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: Everyone who enters the tent and everyone already in the tent will be unclean for seven days,
public_domain_references.web: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.asv: This is the law when a man dieth in a tent: every one that cometh into the tent, and every one that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.kjv: This [is] the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that [is] in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.brenton: And this [is] the law; if a man die in a house, every one that goes into the house, and all things in the house, shall be unclean seven days.

pob.text: And every open vessel that does not have a tied cover on it is unclean.

spob.text: And any open container without a cover tied securely over it is unclean.

public_domain_references.bsb: and any open container without a lid fastened on it is unclean.
public_domain_references.web: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.
public_domain_references.asv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
public_domain_references.kjv: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, [is] unclean.
public_domain_references.brenton: And every open vessel which has not a covering bound upon it, shall be unclean.

pob.text: And everyone who touches[a], in the open field, one slain by the sword, or a dead body, or a human bone, or a grave[c][b], shall be unclean seven days.

spob.text: Anyone who is out in the open and touches someone killed with a sword, a dead body, a human bone, or a grave will be ritually unclean for seven days.

public_domain_references.bsb: Anyone in the open field who touches someone who has been killed by the sword or has died of natural causes, or anyone who touches a human bone or a grave, will be unclean for seven days.
public_domain_references.web: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.asv: And whosoever in the open field toucheth one that is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.kjv: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
public_domain_references.brenton: And every one who shall touch a man slain by violence, or a corpse, or human bone, or sepulchre, shall be unclean seven days.

pob.text: And for the unclean person they shall take some of the dust from the burning of the purification offering[b][a], and he shall put living water on it in a vessel.

spob.text: For a person who is unclean, someone must take some of the dust left from burning the purification offering.[a] In a container, they must add fresh or flowing water to the dust.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: For the purification of the unclean person, take some of the ashes of the burnt sin offering, put them in a jar, and pour fresh water over them.
public_domain_references.web: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.
public_domain_references.asv: And for the unclean they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin-offering; and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
public_domain_references.kjv: And for an unclean [person] they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
public_domain_references.brenton: And they shall take for the unclean of the burnt ashes of purification, and they shall pour upon them running water into a vessel.

pob.text: Then a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it in the water[a], and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on the one who touched the bone, or the slain body, or the dead person[b], or the grave.

spob.text: Then a man who is ritually clean must take hyssop[a] and dip it into the water. He must sprinkle the water on the tent, all the objects in it, everyone who had been there, and anyone who had touched a human bone, the body of someone who was killed, a dead person, or a grave.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then a man who is ceremonially clean is to take some hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle the tent, all the furnishings, and the people who were there. He is also to sprinkle the one who touched a bone, a grave, or a person who has died or been slain.
public_domain_references.web: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.
public_domain_references.asv: and a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave:
public_domain_references.kjv: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip [it] in the water, and sprinkle [it] upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
public_domain_references.brenton: And a clean man shall take hyssop, and dip it into the water, and sprinkle it upon the house, and the furniture, and all the souls that are therein, and upon him that touched the human bone, or the slain man, or the corpse, or the tomb.

pob.text: And the clean person shall sprinkle it on the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day; thus he shall purify him on the seventh day. Then he shall wash his clothes and bathe in water[a], and he shall be clean at evening.

spob.text: A ritually clean person must sprinkle the purification water on the ritually unclean person on the third and seventh days. In this way, the clean person must purify the unclean person on the seventh day. The person being purified must then wash their clothes and bathe in water. At evening, they will be ritually clean.

public_domain_references.bsb: The man who is ceremonially clean is to sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. After he purifies the unclean person on the seventh day, the one being cleansed must wash his clothes and bathe in water, and that evening he will be clean.
public_domain_references.web: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.
public_domain_references.asv: and the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify him; and he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the clean [person] shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
